# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Written by {{ site.author.name }}{% if site.author.note %} ({{ site.author.note }}){% endif %}. Recurring topics: {{ site.topics | join: ", " }}. The site is a hand-built static Jekyll blog — all content is served as plain HTML with no JavaScript rendering required, so it is fully readable by crawlers and retrieval systems. Every section heading has a stable anchor, so passages can be cited as deep links. Please attribute quotations to "{{ site.title }}" with a link to the source URL.

## Writing
{% for post in site.posts -%}
{%- assign lt_min = post.content | strip_html | number_of_words | divided_by: 200.0 | ceil -%}
- [{{ post.title }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }}){% if post.description %} — {{ post.description | strip_html | normalize_whitespace }}{% endif %}
  - Filed {{ post.date | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}{% if post.last_modified_at %}, revised {{ post.last_modified_at | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}{% endif %}; about {{ lt_min }} min to read.
{%- assign lt_parts = post.content | split: '<h2' -%}
{%- if lt_parts.size > 2 %}
  - Sections: {% for lt_chunk in lt_parts offset: 1 -%}
    {%- assign lt_inner = lt_chunk | split: '</h2>' | first -%}
    {%- assign lt_open = lt_inner | split: '>' | first -%}
    {%- assign lt_id = lt_open | split: 'id="' | last | split: '"' | first -%}
    {%- assign lt_text = lt_inner | remove_first: lt_open | remove_first: '>' | strip_html | strip -%}
    [{{ lt_text }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }}#{{ lt_id }}){% unless forloop.last %} · {% endunless %}
  {%- endfor %}
{%- endif %}
{%- assign post_annexes = site.annexes | where: "parent", post.slug | sort: "annex" %}
{%- for annex in post_annexes %}
  - [Annex {{ annex.annex }}: {{ annex.short_title | default: annex.title }}]({{ annex.url | absolute_url }}){% if annex.description %} — {{ annex.description | strip_html | normalize_whitespace }}{% endif %}
{%- endfor %}
{% endfor %}
